delivery_authority.frontier_digest_basis: sha256 of ascending atom_id, tab, carrier sha256, newline records

outcomes: Carrier is a Base Entity governed by Delivery and is no longer modeled as Artifact/Carrier or another bearer-dependent Property.
CARRIES and IS_CARRIED_BY explicitly relate Carrier and exact Artifact Revision in opposite directions.
File Carrier, Directory Carrier, and Native Entity Carrier keep Carrier kind separate from Format, extension, and identity.
Every represented Folder is a Directory Carrier for one Relational Artifact; direct and recursive containment derive only from canonical nesting.
CONTAINS and IS_CONTAINED_BY are never persisted as independent relation declarations.
Frontmatter, main content, filenames, directories, status placement, Journal serialization, projected files, and materialization rules are Delivery authority.

Applicable Methodology uses projected RMEDO Atom File Carriers with exact source revision identity and repository-relative source Carrier paths; no monolithic JSON methodology or persistent Subject Index Carrier is permitted.
Concrete CAPRMEDIO roots and Project directories now live in Local Configuration Delivery authority.
